title: 受限空间作业
source_doc: course/高校实验室安全/140_受限空间作业.md
author_source: project/高校实验室安全/140_受限空间作业/src.py

points.K6: 隔离到位，条件齐了才进

shots.scene: 欣欣站在一个打开的井口围栏外
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands outside a fenced open manhole on a campus road, looking at the camera.
shots.narration: 第12章第三课：受限空间作业。

shots.scene: 欣欣指着井口，竖起手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at the dark manhole opening and raises one finger in warning.
shots.narration: 看着普通的井口，可能一口气就倒下。

shots.scene: 阿杰的手机从栏杆缝掉进路边污水井
shots.prompt_en: The young male student drops his phone through a gap into an open roadside sewer manhole on campus.
shots.narration: 阿杰的手机，掉进了路边的井里。

shots.scene: 阿杰蹲在井边，想往下爬
shots.prompt_en: The young male student kneels at the manhole edge and puts one foot on the ladder going down.
shots.narration: 井不深，他想下去捡。

shots.scene: 小研一把拉住他
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student grabs his arm and pulls him back from the manhole.
shots.narration: 小研：别下去！里面可能缺氧！

shots.scene: 两人站在井口外，井里黑漆漆
shots.prompt_en: Both students stand back from the dark manhole, a faint invisible gas icon rising from it.
shots.narration: 危险看不见，也闻不出来。

shots.scene: 井、罐、管道剖面，出入口都很窄
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: cutaways of a manhole, a tank and a pipe, each with a narrow opening. No text.
shots.narration: 进出口受限，部分或全部封闭。

shots.scene: 人只在检修时进去，平时不待人
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a worker entering a tank only for inspection, a bed and a desk icon crossed out inside. No text.
shots.narration: 不是给人长期待的地方。

shots.scene: 空气流动差的箭头
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a closed space with weak, stagnant air arrows inside. No text.
shots.narration: 通风不良，有害气体容易积聚。

shots.scene: 开阔的广场打叉不算
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: left, a closed tank with a warning icon; right, an open plaza with free flowing air arrows and a green tick. No text.
shots.narration: 国内也叫有限空间，开阔场地不算。

shots.scene: 污水井、化粪池、水池、管道井
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: campus icons, a sewer manhole, a septic tank, a water tank and a pipe shaft. No text.
shots.narration: 校园里：污水井、化粪池、水池、管井。

shots.scene: 储罐、锅炉、深坑、通风管道
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: icons of a storage tank, a boiler, a deep pit and a large ventilation duct. No text.
shots.narration: 储罐、锅炉、深坑、大风管也算。

shots.scene: 空的化学品罐剖面，残留在挥发
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a cutaway of an empty chemical tank with residue evaporating inside. No text.
shots.narration: 空罐也算，残留物会挥发。

shots.scene: 【实拍】校园污水井盖上锁，旁边立着警示标志（中景）
shots.prompt_en: Medium shot: a locked manhole cover on a campus road with a confined space warning sign standing beside it.
shots.narration: 摸清位置，设警示标志，井盖锁好。

shots.scene: 缺氧、有毒、可燃三个气体图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three invisible gas icons, low oxygen, toxic gas and flammable gas, inside a tank. No text.
shots.narration: 主要危害：缺氧、中毒、燃爆。

shots.scene: 工人刚吸两口气就倒下的示意
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a worker silhouette collapsing after two breath icons inside a tank, red warning. No text.
shots.narration: 缺氧和毒气，几口就能放倒人。

shots.scene: 可燃气遇火花爆燃
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: flammable gas in a pit meeting a small spark and flashing into flame. No text.
shots.narration: 可燃气体一遇火，就会着火爆炸。

shots.scene: 湿滑、照明差、温度极端
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: icons of a slippery floor, a dim bulb and a thermometer at both extremes. No text.
shots.narration: 湿滑、照明差、闷热或极冷。

shots.scene: 被水或物料淹没的剖面
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a cutaway of a pit filling quickly with water and loose material. No text.
shots.narration: 还可能被水或物料淹没。

shots.scene: 里面焊接、化学清洗、打磨，警告加倍
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: welding, chemical cleaning and grinding icons inside a tank, warning icons doubling. No text.
shots.narration: 在里面焊、洗、磨，危害更多。

shots.scene: 空气成分饼图，氧气约五分之一
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a pie chart of air, one fifth oxygen and most of the rest nitrogen. No text.
shots.narration: 空气里的氧气，约占百分之二十一。

shots.scene: 氧气条降低，人头晕倒下
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an oxygen level bar dropping low, a person getting dizzy and fainting. No text.
shots.narration: 氧气低了叫缺氧，人会头晕、窒息。

shots.scene: 氧气条升高，火焰更旺
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an oxygen level bar rising high, a small flame growing much bigger. No text.
shots.narration: 氧气多了叫富氧，东西更易着火。

shots.scene: 液氮房间的氧含量报警器
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an oxygen alarm on the wall of a liquid nitrogen room, a cylinder of oxygen kept away from oil. No text.
shots.narration: 实验室用液氮，也要看氧含量报警。

shots.scene: 标准书，合格范围按国家标准
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a closed national standard book beside an oxygen bar with a green middle zone. No text.
shots.narration: 合格范围，按国家标准执行。

shots.scene: 作业审批表盖章
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a blank confined space entry permit receiving a stamp. No text.
shots.narration: 进有限空间作业，一律先审批。

shots.scene: 有危险气体才审批打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a gas cloud icon with a permit only beside it, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 不是测出毒气才审批，而是一律审批。

shots.scene: 负责人、安全员、监护人到场
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a manager, a safety officer and an attendant standing together at a manhole with the permit. No text.
shots.narration: 负责人、安全员、监护人都要到位。

shots.scene: 工人出示培训和授权卡
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a worker showing a blank training certificate and an authorization card. No text.
shots.narration: 进去的人，受过培训、获得授权。

shots.section_title: 隔离到位，条件齐了才进
shots.scene: 关阀上锁、断电挂牌
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: pipes into a tank closed with locked valves, the power switched off with a tag. No text.
shots.narration: 先隔离：关阀加盲板，断电上锁。
overlay: 隔离到位，条件齐了才进

shots.section_title: 隔离到位，条件齐了才进
shots.scene: 井口围挡、警示
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: barriers and warning signs set up around an open manhole. No text.
shots.narration: 井口围挡警示，防止路人掉落。

shots.section_title: 隔离到位，条件齐了才进
shots.scene: 清单：通风、检测、照明、监护、救援
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a checklist with five icons, a fan, a gas detector, a lamp, an attendant and a rescue tripod, all ticked. No text.
shots.narration: 通风、检测、照明、监护、救援都齐。

shots.section_title: 隔离到位，条件齐了才进
shots.scene: 全部打勾，才签发进入
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: all boxes ticked, then a pen signing the entry permit. No text.
shots.narration: 条件都齐了，才签发进入。

shots.scene: 三个步骤箭头：风扇→检测仪→工人
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three steps in a row with arrows, a fan, a gas detector, then a worker entering. No text.
shots.narration: 顺序不能乱：先通风、再检测、后作业。

shots.scene: 顺序颠倒的打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a worker entering first and the detector coming later, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 先进去再测，就晚了。

shots.scene: 中断后再进，又从通风检测开始
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a clock showing a break, then the three steps restarting from the fan. No text.
shots.narration: 中断后再进，要重新通风检测。

shots.scene: 送风机送新风，排风扇往外抽
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a blower pushing fresh air into a tank through a duct and an exhaust fan pulling air out. No text.
shots.narration: 用送风机送新风，排风扇往外抽。

shots.scene: 进入前和作业中都开着风机
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the blower running before entry and still running while a worker is inside. No text.
shots.narration: 进入前和作业中，都要机械通风。

shots.scene: 氧气瓶接风管打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an oxygen cylinder connected to a ventilation duct, crossed out with a fire icon. No text.
shots.narration: 严禁用纯氧通风，会引发火灾。

shots.scene: 蒸气云：加热打叉，排风扇打勾
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a vapor cloud in a tank, a heater crossed out and an exhaust fan with a tick. No text.
shots.narration: 里面的蒸气云，用排风抽走，绝不加热。

shots.scene: 专人拿检测仪在井口
shots.prompt_en: A trained technician holds a portable gas detector at the edge of a manhole before entry.
shots.narration: 开工前，由有资格的人检测。

shots.scene: 氧、可燃、有毒三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three icons, an oxygen molecule, a flame and a toxic skull cloud, all with ticks. No text.
shots.narration: 氧含量、可燃气、有毒气，三样都测。

shots.scene: 先测氧气，再测其他
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a numbered order, oxygen first, then flammable gas, then toxic gas. No text.
shots.narration: 先测氧，氧不够其他读数也不准。

shots.scene: 【实拍】在井口外用检测仪的采样管伸入井内泵吸检测（手部特写）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: hands lowering the sampling tube of a portable gas detector into a manhole from outside.
shots.narration: 在外面用采样管测，人不下去。

shots.scene: 井里上中下三个测点
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a cutaway of a deep pit with three sampling points at the top, middle and bottom. No text.
shots.narration: 上中下都要测，气体会分层。

shots.scene: 工人胸前挂着检测仪作业
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a worker inside a tank with a gas detector clipped to his chest. No text.
shots.narration: 作业中持续检测，随身带检测仪。

shots.scene: 开着风机也照样检测
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a running blower and a gas detector side by side, both with ticks. No text.
shots.narration: 开着通风，也不能省掉检测。

shots.scene: 检测仪报警，工人立即往外撤
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a gas detector flashing red and a worker climbing out of a manhole quickly. No text.
shots.narration: 一报警，立刻撤出。

shots.scene: 安全电压的照明灯
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a low voltage work lamp inside a tank with a safety voltage icon. No text.
shots.narration: 照明和手持工具，用安全特低电压。

shots.scene: 防爆灯、通道畅通
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an explosion proof lamp and a clear entry ladder with nothing blocking it. No text.
shots.narration: 有可燃气的地方用防爆灯，通道畅通。

shots.scene: 工人轮换进出、补水
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two workers swapping places at the opening, one drinking water and stretching. No text.
shots.narration: 又闷又热，控制时间，轮换进出。

shots.scene: 监护人守在井口，看着井下
shots.prompt_en: A safety attendant in a reflective vest stands at the manhole edge watching the worker below.
shots.narration: 监护人守在外面，寸步不离。

shots.scene: 进出登记表
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a blank entry and exit log board at the manhole with names as blank lines and a clock. No text.
shots.narration: 登记每个人的进出。

shots.scene: 监护人用对讲机和井下保持联络
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the attendant talking on a radio with the worker below, sound wave icons. No text.
shots.narration: 和里面的人，时刻保持联络。

shots.scene: 拦住无关人员
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the attendant stopping a passer by at the barrier with a raised hand. No text.
shots.narration: 不让无关的人进去。

shots.scene: 发现异常，呼叫撤离和救援
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the attendant calling on a phone with an alarm icon while the worker is pulled out. No text.
shots.narration: 懂危害、会应急，有异常就呼救。

shots.scene: 隔绝式空气呼吸器与过滤式口罩对比
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a self contained breathing apparatus with a tick, a filter mask crossed out next to a low oxygen icon. No text.
shots.narration: 缺氧时，过滤式口罩不能补氧。

shots.scene: 浓度不明的问号，用隔绝式
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a question mark gas cloud and a self contained breathing apparatus beside it. No text.
shots.narration: 立即危及生命或浓度不明，用隔绝式。

shots.scene: 三脚架、安全带、救援绳、报警哨
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a rescue tripod over a manhole, a full body harness, a lifeline and a whistle. No text.
shots.narration: 安全带、救援绳、三脚架提前备好。

shots.scene: 救援预案人人熟悉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a team gathered around a blank rescue plan on a board. No text.
shots.narration: 人人熟悉应急救援预案。

shots.scene: 定期救援演练
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a team practicing a rescue with a dummy at a training manhole, a calendar with repeating marks. No text.
shots.narration: 定期演练，出事才不慌乱。

shots.scene: 一个人倒下，接连下去的人也倒下
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a chain of three worker silhouettes collapsing one after another inside a pit, red cross. No text.
shots.narration: 盲目下去救人，往往一倒一串。

shots.scene: 监护人不下井
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the attendant at the manhole edge with a stop hand, a ladder going down crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 监护人不能下去救人。

shots.scene: 在井外用救援绳往上拉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the attendant turning a winch on the rescue tripod, lifting a worker by a lifeline. No text.
shots.narration: 系好的救援绳，在井外往上拉。

shots.scene: 拨打119、120，报告保卫处
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a phone icon with the numbers 119 and 120, and an arrow to the campus security office. No text.
shots.narration: 打119、120，报告保卫处。

shots.scene: 佩戴呼吸器的专业救援人员下井
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: professional rescuers wearing breathing apparatus entering the manhole with a lifeline. No text.
shots.narration: 只有配齐装备的专业人员才能进。

shots.scene: 学生站在井边被拦住
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a student at a manhole edge with a stop hand in front of him. No text.
shots.narration: 学生和实验室人员，不得擅自进入。

shots.scene: 阿杰打电话给后勤
shots.prompt_en: The young male student calls the campus logistics office on another phone beside the closed manhole.
shots.narration: 东西掉了，找后勤，交给专业队伍。

shots.scene: 施工单位资质证书和学校审批章
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a contractor's blank qualification certificate and a school approval stamp. No text.
shots.narration: 作业单位有资质，学校审批监管。

shots.scene: 井口和三步箭头
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two icons, a manhole and three arrows for ventilation, testing and work. No text.
shots.narration: 先审批，先通风、再检测、后作业。

shots.scene: 检测仪和监护人
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two icons, a gas detector with an alarm and an attendant at the opening. No text.
shots.narration: 持续检测，报警就撤，监护人守外面。

shots.scene: 救援绳和电话
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two icons, a rescue tripod with a lifeline and a phone. No text.
shots.narration: 出了事，不盲目施救，在外呼救。

shots.scene: 欣欣系着全身式安全带挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot wearing a full body safety harness waves goodbye beside a guardrail.
shots.narration: 下一课：高处作业与坠落防护。
